# Overview

```{=html}
<div id="trm-structure-summary" class="trm-structure-cards"></div>
<div class="trm-structure-note">
Components are coordinate-supported hypotheses. “Composite candidate” and
“nested candidate” are not confirmed biological structures until reads or an
assembled insertion sequence demonstrate linkage between components.
</div>
```

# Structure catalogue

## Multi-component event interpretations

This event-level table aggregates all supporting insertion sequences. It is the
first place to inspect when looking for several TE components at one call.

```{=html}
<div class="trm-structure-table-wrap">
  <table class="trm-structure-table">
    <thead><tr><th>Location</th><th>Event</th><th>Reported TE</th><th>Query sequences</th><th>Queries with components</th><th>Multi-component queries</th><th>Multi-family queries</th><th>Maximum components</th><th>Interpretation</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody id="trm-event-body"></tbody>
  </table>
</div>
```

# Interpretation and thresholds

The report retains every raw HSP in `insertion-hsps.tsv`. Thresholds only
control normalized matches and provisional component proposals; rejected HSPs
are never silently deleted. Exact values and input checksums are recorded in
`manifest.json`.
